scope: R246 clarifies native source-resolution status for Noether Papers 17 and 18 against the current R225 German base. It carries current R225 anchor extracts, compact best-source witnesses, resolution ledgers, and prior applied-fix/no-fix ledgers.
result: No TeX patch. R227 already showed that the P17 formula (39) footnotes 21/22 and P18 Hentzelt resultant/norm anchor survive in R225. R246 clarifies source quality and resolves a stale P18 source-route contradiction.
quality_caveat: P17 source PDF embeds 36 page images at native 600ppi. P18 now has a verified official GDZ/JDMV 30 printed p101 page image/PDF at native 600ppi, superseding the old RA51 caveat that GDZ p101 was a different article. Both remain below the strict 650ppi full-page certification floor. Old 1000dpi crops are enlarged known-locus witnesses only, not native 1000ppi authority.
recommended_action: Preserve current P17/P18 R225 TeX, do not replay older P17/P18 fixes, and do not repeat the stale RA51 wrong-article statement for P18. Reopen only against concrete mismatch or stronger native source.
specific_traps: P17 formula (39): keep both restored source footnotes 21 and 22 around the displayed equality ending and the line with a_sigma.
P18 resultant display: preserve R^(n)(x_n) congruent to 0 modulo M, not equality and not another final factor index.
P18 page route: GDZ printed p101 is verified for the Noether/Hentzelt note but is 600ppi, not strict-certified.
